text.insert: Processing stages evidence before acceptance and publishes only at the source class's authority boundary. The background sink continuously accepts eligible worker-result evidence; every other source stages for operator-initiated sync.

A serialized materializer may advance completed-worker-evidence knowledge during a run. Discord and static corpora publish during sync, including a knowledge-only pass if upstream did not move. Merged-PR knowledge publishes with the reconciled sync boundary. Review evidence ingestion stays separate from fixer execution.

Succeeded means outputs were accepted and provenance recorded. Acceptance is idempotent for one source artifact and records source identity, job and attempt lineage, input revision, output revision, and trace evidence. Cancellation never deletes knowledge accepted by an earlier job.
